Class Tile

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.map.Tile
public class Tile extends Object
Represents a single cell in the GameMap grid.

Each tile has a TileType that defines its terrain and a Position (the centre of the tile in game-world coordinates). The walkable and buildable properties are derived from the TileType so they stay consistent automatically.

The grid uses integer indices [x][y] where each tile covers a 1×1 area: a tile at grid[3][5] has its centre at game-world position (3.5, 5.5).
